_comment: MC-031 is a sworn statement attached to another court paper ("This form must be attached to another form or court paper before it can be filed in court"); in this packet it is a witness's statement attached to DV-100, brought in by DV-100's "Does someone else ... want to give a signed statement...?". The parties are answers DV-100 already has. The declarant is the witness, so the name and the statement are asked; the witness signs it. The statement continues on MC-025. Field names come from the rectangles (pipeline-field-labels.js): FillText10 and 9 are the parties, 11 the case number, 8 the statement, 14 the date, 7 the printed name; the role boxes under the signature are for a lawyer signing for a party.

fields.label: Case number
fields._why: The court gives the case number when the request is filed; like every case number in the packet it is left for the clerk.

fields.label: Attorney for (under the signature)
fields._why: Only when a lawyer signs for a party; the declarant signs as themself.

fields.label: Plaintiff (under the signature)
fields._why: The party a signing lawyer represents; the declarant signs as themself.
